title: Kafka - JsonObject serializer and deserializer not included in native image
body:
The issue has been reported by @michalszynkiewicz. So just re-transcribing:

It seems that in 0.17.0, the (Vert.x) JsonObject serializer and deserializer are not embedded in the native image. 

https://gist.github.com/michalszynkiewicz/d527479cc4ce72a1addc61801ba34458
